scientific_integrity: A parameter-uniform self-contained proof establishes integral homotopy types. Exact finite checks independently corroborate the formula; no independent scientific audit or externally certified proof has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to binary configurations with precisely three grains on consistently oriented finite cycles; it does not treat arbitrary grain counts or the full configuration-space question. Finite checks run through n=30; the all-n conclusion uses a complete elementary-collapse proof.
title: Complete three-grain avalanche homotopy types on directed cycles
